select count(*) as count from tb_faq where faq_del_yn = 'N'
and faq_name like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
and faq_content like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
and (faq_name like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR faq_content like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
and faq_writer_name = #{searchWord}

select faq_seq_no as faqSeqNo , faq_name as faqName , faq_content as faqContent , faq_hit_cnt as faqHitCnt , faq_date as faqDate , faq_writer as faqWriter , faq_writer_name as faqWriterName , faq_up_date as faqUpDate , faq_up_user as faqUpUser , faq_del_yn as faqDelYn , faq_del_date as faqDelDate , faq_del_user as faqDelUser from tb_faq where faq_seq_no = #{faqSeqNo}
